page_title: UNI 3-4 BOC | Union Berlin v Bochum 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Manuel Riemann.
90+5' Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+3' Josip Juranovic sends the ball into the centre of the box from the corner. Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) bursts through a crowd of players but heads the ball miles wide of the left post.
90+3' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) prepares to take a corner kick.
90+2' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Union Berlin.
90+1' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' Nenad Bjelica has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) replacing Rani Khedira.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) is coming onto the pitch as Felix Passlack cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner kick, but Frederik Ronnow reads it well and stops the effort.
85' The free kick into the penalty area from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is cleared.
85' Felix Passlack (Bochum) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Fritz signals. Union Berlin have a free kick.
84' A pass from Bernardo gives Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) a shooting opportunity on the edge of the box, but the effort is poor and goes well wide of the right post.
83' Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) attempts to feed Lukas Daschner with a chip pass, but Frederik Ronnow reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
81' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
80' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
79' Here is a change. Philipp Hofmann is going off and Heiko Butscher gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Erhan Masovic (Bochum) comes onto the pitch for Matus Bero.

76' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Manuel Riemann pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the left side of the goal.
74' 3 - 4 Goal - 3:4! Brenden Aaronson laid the ball off to Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
74' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:15. 4:5 – this is the current number of shots on target.
70' 2 - 4 Goal! Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) makes the score 2:4 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Felix Passlack.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Kral (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch so that Andras Schafer can be given a rest.
69' The resulting corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is cleared by the defence.
67' Heiko Butscher has decided to substitute Maximilian Wittek and he is replaced by Tim Oermann (Bochum).
67' Here comes a substitution. Moritz Broschinski is given a rest as he is replaced by Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum).

65' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
65' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
65' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.

63' 2 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Andras Schafer, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Chris Bedia (Union Berlin), who beats Manuel Riemann with a brilliant shot into the right side of the net. 2:3.

59' 1 - 3 Nice piece of skill by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin). He perfectly collected a pass from Robin Gosens and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:3.
57' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
54' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) picks out Benedict Hollerbach with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.

50' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Ivan Ordets (Bochum) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
50' The corner kick from Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
50' Felix Passlack (Bochum) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
49' One of the players from Union Berlin times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
47' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
46' Half-time substitution. Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) is replaced by Chris Bedia.
46' Nenad Bjelica has made a change at the break. Brenden Aaronson has come on in place of Kevin Volland (Union Berlin).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Nenad Bjelica probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin). He is replaced by Yorbe Vertessen.
46' Marco Fritz blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.

45+1' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the target, but Frederik Ronnow keeps the ball out.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Bernardo (Bochum) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
41' There's an opportunity for Kevin Stoger (Bochum) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

41' A lofted cross from Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' 0 - 3 Goal! Felix Passlack plays it to Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Frederik Ronnow. 0:3.
36' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
35' Matus Bero (Bochum) has an effort from distance but it's blocked. Good work from Bochum as they win a corner.

34' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the left side of the goal, but Manuel Riemann keeps it out.

33' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) brings his opponent down. Marco Fritz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Union Berlin will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

33' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) receives a quality pass and unleashes a rocket of a shot from distance, but his amazing effort goes just over the crossbar. The goalkeeper probably wouldn't have saved this one.

31' 0 - 2 Patrick Osterhage produces a sweet pass and picks out Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:2!
30' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Manuel Riemann, who smothers the ball.
29' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
28' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

27' Poor challenge! Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is penalised for tripping and Marco Fritz blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Bochum, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
25' 1:3 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:1.
21' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Kevin Stoger (Bochum), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
19' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) should have done it better. He won the ball from the resulting free kick, but fired high over the crossbar.
19' A clumsy foul by Bernardo (Bochum) and Marco Fritz blows his whistle. Union Berlin win a free kick.

16' 0 - 1 What a goal! Moritz Broschinski plays it to Maximilian Wittek (Bochum), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Frederik Ronnow into the right side of the goal. 0:1.
15' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Manuel Riemann.
13' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

12' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Union Berlin will take a corner.
11' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
10' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
3' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Marco Fritz will officiate today.
